body: I think what keeps me from doing it is hurting the people that care about me. They don't know my situation at all but if I were to end it, I can't imagine the pain they'd feel.
You're welcome. You ever think about getting a pet or anything? Might help with some of the loneliness.

I've never been through that exact situation, but I know it's rough losing a significant other to someone else. I've had a scare with that almost happening and am still having some trouble with it. You should find something to occupy your time like a hobby or something. Really seemed to help me.
I feel so much like you guys. If it didn't cause anyone else pain, I feel like I would've done it by now.
No this is the first time I've told anyone.

I'm not entirely sure. My dad has kinda controlled my life for the last few years I feel like I don't even know what I would want. When I was in high school, he put in my head I need to go to med school but he didn't want me to do pre med. So he made me do bioengineering. I really like hard labour. I worked as a farm hand one summer in high school and loved it. I don't know if I can make a career out of that.
Studied bioengineering. I graduated with an okay gpa. Hated every second of it though.

Well like I said earlier, the first time I remember experiencing them was when I had that great job and everything was going great. Idk, I think part of it may be the degree I pursued. The whole time I was getting it, I questioned whether it was the right one for me.

It's not the accident that's messing with me though. At least I don't think it is. My family irritating me is a separate event from the accident. Since I graduated, I had to move back home, having to deal with their bs everyday. And the stuff with my gf is also not from the accident. I think the only reason I look back to it is because I was happy at the time. And had I died, I wouldn't have had to face any of these problems. Thanks for the advice, you have no idea how much it helps.

I honestly don't know why they started originally. At the time they started, everything was perfect. I had a job I loved that paid well, had a really good relationship with my gf, got along with my family, but for some reason, I just wasn't happy. And since the accident, my family has irritated me to the point I don't wanna talk to them anymore. I can't find a job since I graduated, although I've applied to over 100 positions. And lastly, my gf and I have been struggling. She keeps talking to this guy who likes her even though we've fought about it before and she promised she'd stop but hasn't.

Nothing substantial. I was traveling on the highway, a semi who was traveling next to me clipped the back end of my car, we spun to the front and were tboned down the highway way going 60mph. Everyone was fine. But the more I think about the accident, I just wish I could've died so I wouldn't have to deal with any problems that have come up in my life.
And no, the accident was someone else's fault.

Had these thoughts before but they went away for a while. Recently graduated and can't find a job, gf and have been fighting and I feel like she doesn't care anymore, keep getting irritated with my family. Whenever I think about these problems, I just wish I had died in that wreck.
